about: DEE Development Engineers Ltd is a design -led engineering and manufacturing company supplying specialised high-pressure process piping systems, pipe spools, fittings and bends, modular skids, pressure vessels and heavy-fabrication products. It serves power -including nuclear - oil & gas, refining, petrochemical, chemical and fertiliser industries, with manufacturing operations in India and Thailand. [1] [2]
